name: metamodel.addProperty
title: Add property to type
summary: Give a type an existing property or a new one, required or not; only the metamodel files that have the type and the new definition change, line by line.
details: The key goes at the end of the type's own `required` list when `required` is true, else of its own `properties` list, in the file the type is in (created after the definition's last line when missing); a key the list holds already without a definition is not added twice. Other types that list the key of a new property have it from then on, and `listedBy` names them. A new property is added at the end of `properties` in the first metamodel file by name that has the list, else at the end of the first file, where the list is created (SR-236 AK4); it takes its name, key, value kind and the fields of the kind (fixed values, target types, several values, maximum entries, SR-171); every other field is set with metamodel.changeProperty (SR-238 AK1). Without `key`, the key is made from the name as metamodel.addType makes it, and so is the key of a fixed value without one (SR-236 AK6). Every other line stays as it was, with its comment and line ending (SR-236 AK3); no element file changes and nothing in Git (D-036). The metamodel afterwards is checked as a read would check it: an error refuses the command, warnings are in `problems` (SR-236 AK1); elements that now miss a required property are counted in `missingRequired` (SR-236 AK9). Errors: input.invalid with details.reason unknown when no type or no property has the key (details.type or details.property); input.invalid with details.reason has-property when the type has the property already, itself or inherited (details.type, details.property); input.invalid with details.reason property-or-new when the input gives both `property` and fields of a new property, or neither `property` nor `name` and `kind`; input.invalid with details.reason kind-field when a field does not belong to the value kind: fixed values without kind `choice`, target types without `relation`, maximum entries with `relation` (details.field, details.kind); input.invalid with details.reason single-value when `maxItems` is given without `many: true`; input.invalid with details.reason taken when another property has the name or the key, a relation kind has the key, or two fixed values have the same name or key (details.field, details.key); input.invalid with details.reason key-required when no key is given and the one made from the name is empty, does not start with a letter, is longer than 64 characters, or is taken (details.key); input.invalid with details.reason metamodel-invalid and the errors in details.problems when the metamodel would have an error, also for the key `id`, `type` or `status`, which every element file holds itself (D-012); workspace.read-only when the metamodel files do not give a valid metamodel or the metamodel repository is not on this machine; input.invalid with details.reason git-folder when the metamodel folder is .git or a repository of its own (D-036); file.read-only when the metamodel repository cannot be written (SR-018 AK2); file.faulty when a changed definition, or a node on the way to it, holds a YAML alias or anchor (details.repository, details.file, details.line); file.changed-on-disk when another process changed a file since it was read (SR-236 AK10). Nothing is written on these.
whileReadOnlyReason: SR-236 AK5: a metamodel that cannot be read is never changed (SR-011 AK3).

type.description: Key of the type that gets the property.

required.description: true: the property is required in the type (its key goes into the type's `required`); false: into its `properties`.

property.description: Key of an existing property the type has neither itself nor inherited. Not with the fields of a new property.

name.description: Display name of a new property; no other property may have it.

key.description: Fixed key of a new property (D-043), not that of another property or relation kind. Left out: made from the name (SR-236 AK6).

kind.description: Value kind of a new property.

name.description: Display name of the fixed value; no other fixed value of the property may have it.

key.description: Fixed key of the value (D-043). Left out: made from the name (SR-236 AK6).

choices.description: Fixed values of a new property of kind `choice`, in this order.

targetTypes.description: Allowed target types of a new property of kind `relation`; left out: every type.

many.description: true: a new property holds a list of values.

maxItems.description: At most this many entries in the list of a new property with `many` (SR-171); not for kind `relation`.

type.title: Type
type.description: Key of the type that has the property now.

property.title: Property
property.description: The property's definition as written afterwards.

required.title: Required
required.description: Whether the type requires the property afterwards.

defined.title: New definition
defined.description: true when the property's definition was added to the metamodel.

listedBy.title: Also listed by
listedBy.description: Other types that list the key of the new property already, without a definition before; they have the property now too.

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root.

versionsChanged.title: Versions changed
versionsChanged.description: Elements whose version is another under the new metamodel (SR-015 AK4): elements of a type whose counted properties change and that have a value for one of them, such as elements of a type that was unknown before; those of `versionsChangedElements`.

missingRequired.title: Missing required properties
missingRequired.description: Elements that now miss a value of a required property they did not miss before (SR-015 AK3); those of `missingRequiredElements`.

versionsChangedElements.title: Elements with another version
versionsChangedElements.description: The elements `versionsChanged` counts, in store order.

missingRequiredElements.title: Elements missing a required property
missingRequiredElements.description: The elements `missingRequired` counts, in store order.

problems.title: Problems
problems.description: The warnings of the metamodel afterwards (SR-236 AK1).
